title: The 2011 Norway Terror Attacks
evidence: Extensive digital and physical evidence connected Breivik to the attacks
A vehicle bomb detonated in central Oslo
Firearms and ammunition were used during the Utøya attack
Breivik was arrested at the Utøya crime scene
He admitted carrying out the attacks
modus_operandi: Breivik planned the attacks over an extended period, prepared explosives and firearms, detonated a vehicle bomb in Oslo, and subsequently traveled to Utøya where he systematically shot people attending a youth political camp.
personality_disorder: A second court-appointed psychiatric evaluation diagnosed Antisocial Personality Disorder and Narcissistic Personality Disorder and concluded that Breivik was not psychotic at the time of the attacks.
summary: Norwegian mass murderer responsible for the 2011 attacks in Oslo and Utøya. Unlike the serial killers in the other records, Breivik carried out a mass-casualty terrorist attack rather than a conventional serial-murder pattern. A second psychiatric evaluation diagnosed Narcissistic Personality Disorder and Antisocial Personality Disorder.
